product.name: Amy, the Receptionist
product.description: An AI agent that handles inbound calls at any time and directs tasks to appropriate staff members.

product.name: Kiara, the CMA
product.description: An AI agent that manages patient triage, care coordination, and intake processes to support clinical staff.

product.name: Ava, the Scribe
product.description: An AI agent that ambiently generates clinical notes customized to the medical specialty and provider's style.

product.name: Emily, the Nurse
product.description: An AI agent that conducts patient assessments, provides education, and monitors patient progress.

product.name: Maya, Pre-Op Clearance
product.description: An AI agent that streamlines pre-surgical screening and ensures all necessary clearances are obtained before surgery.

product.name: Julia, Post-Op Follow Up
product.description: An AI agent that monitors patient recovery, manages post-surgical care instructions, and coordinates follow-up appointments.
